problem_statement: The current HNK frame strongly evokes the nickname domain but does not contain a recovered possession/existential relation equivalent to English HAVE, and the negative no-nickname response path is not governed.
design_principles: Do not create an English-calque HAVE verb by default.
Prefer an analytic possession/existence strategy if it can be governed from recovered grammar or a minimal authored rule.
A beginner yes/no card must support both an affirmative nickname answer and a no-nickname answer before whole-slot validation.
Do not infer the roles of YA/ES from PHR-001 solely to close this card.
Do not promote WATCH/GATE material silently.

candidate_routes.description: Treat EN VAMAKALA KE as a course-level Your nickname? / nickname? interview question and define explicit positive and null/negative answer behavior.
candidate_routes.risk: May underrepresent the original HAVE semantics unless the pedagogical equivalence is explicitly approved.

candidate_routes.description: Recover or author a minimal possession/existence construction that can express having/no nickname without an English-specific auxiliary.
candidate_routes.risk: Requires new grammar governance and negative polarity design.
